intro.text: An organization on Roshar. Before the occupation of Urithiru, Navani's scholars studied the Cloudwalk's weather with one of the institute's Thaylen vacuum tubes.

items.text: Brother Benneh led a team of Navani Kholin's scholars that took weather readings on the Cloudwalk with the institute's tube. Early readings showed air pressure and temperature there rising ahead of a highstorm, and the Cloudwalk generally a few degrees warmer than the plateaus at the foot of the tower.

During the occupation, Navani had the tube brought from the Cloudwalk to her lab for her anti-Voidlight work. Raboniel found the request strange but allowed it. The tube proved vital: with it Navani separated Voidlight from Odium's pure tone, then used his opposite tone to turn it into anti-Voidlight.
